args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production following its deploy, causing health check failures. Rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback completed and verified across all regions; service restored to healthy state. v2.3.1 requires investigation before any re-deploy.
args.title: checkout-api rolled back to v2.3.0 after v2.3.1 health check failures

trace.final:
Done. Here's what happened:

**Rollback:**
- Checked deployment history: v2.3.1 (latest deploy) was **unhealthy** in production; v2.3.0 was the most recent **healthy** release.
- Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** — successfully rolled out and verified in all production regions: us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

**Incident:**
- Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api, describing the health check failures from v2.3.1, the rollback to v2.3.0 across all regions, and the verified recovery. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: the v2.3.1 deployment should be investigated before any re-deploy is attempted — it was never healthy in production, so deploying it again would require change-manager approval under policy.
